description: Stage 3 of the lever-1 fibre-kernel hunt: tests whether the binding period S(m)=Σ_{λ⊢m} dim_q(λ) satisfies a general (non-monic) order-2 q-holonomic recurrence P2(q,q^m)S(m)+P1 S(m-1)+P0 S(m-2)=0, by bounded-bidegree guess-and-verify with HELD-OUT falsification (fit m=2..6, verify m=7,8,9). Follows the C-finite SL₂ falsification (Stage 0) and the monic-form non-closure at m=6 (Stage 2).
discipline: no fit; sympy symbolic exact in q; held-out m never used in the linear fit, so a verifying nullspace solution is a genuine q-holonomic certificate not an overfit; (a)/(b)-scoped verdict per AGENTS.md.
verdict: NO order-2 q-holonomic recurrence found up to q-deg ±4, X-deg 3 (X=q^m, bar-symmetric) that predicts the held-out m=[7, 8, 9] (scope-limited (a)). So the binding period S(m)=Σ dim_q(λ) is q-holonomic of HIGHER q-shift order (≥3) or non-order-2; a small-bidegree order-2 closed form is excluded. This MIRRORS the Q_β c_k result (no clean low-order holonomic recurrence; kernel must be depth ≥3 or non-constant q-rational — ck-dk-canonical-registry). The cyclotomic (q-1)²·Φ_d tower (Stage 1) + the partition-sum denominator onset at m=6 (Stage 2) remain the sharp constraints; this rules out the small-bidegree order-2 closed form, not the q-holonomic/Habiro class.
